statement: Intel shares surged 8.64% on July 21, 2026, attributed in trade press partly to the Google Cloud collaboration, partly to a new foundry customer (Fortinet) and memory-performance items ahead of Q2 earnings.
why: A named new foundry customer is a concrete sign that alternative fabrication capacity is winning work, which matters for how much non-incumbent supply the chain can eventually carry.

impact.mechanism: Foundry customer additions at Intel expand the pool of non-TSMC leading-edge capacity, a slow-moving relief valve on the chain's single-foundry dependence.

confidence.basis: Share move and the Fortinet foundry item are relayed second-hand from unnamed trade press inside one document, with the cause split across several unquantified factors.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: Intel Newsroom
